scenes.heading: Jobs
scenes.narration: A Databricks job runs notebooks, scripts, or pipelines automatically as one or more tasks, without anyone clicking run.

scenes.heading: What jobs give you
scenes.narration: Jobs let you chain multiple tasks with dependencies, so one step waits for another to finish. Each run can use a fresh job cluster that terminates afterward to save cost. And built-in retries plus alerts help the pipeline recover and notify you when something fails.

scenes.heading: A multi-task job
scenes.narration: A typical job ingests raw data as its first task. It then transforms that data into a cleaned silver layer, and aggregates it into gold tables. A final task refreshes the dashboard, and each step only runs once its upstream dependency succeeds.

scenes.text: Use job clusters rather than all-purpose clusters for scheduled work to cut cost and isolate each run.
scenes.narration: Use dedicated job clusters rather than all-purpose clusters for scheduled work, which cuts cost and isolates every run.
